description.text:
[McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1](https://huggingface.co/McGill-NLP/AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1) fine-tuned with full fine-tuning (DeepSpeed ZeRO-3) on [israel/AfriGuard-inst](https://huggingface.co/datasets/israel/AfriGuard-inst): each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is `<safety>…</safety>` `<category>…</category>` `<response>…</response>`.

This is a rerun of the AfriGuard-inst config `afriguard.yaml` from the AfriGuard-model (LlamaFactory) repo, with only the output paths changed (`examples/train_full/afriguard_inst_afriqueqwen3.5-4b-50langs-instruct_full_sft.yaml`), made as the matched baseline for [adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1](https://huggingface.co/adzcai/AfriGuardPlain-AfriqueQwen3.5-4B-50Langs-Instruct-v1), the same setup trained on [adzcai/AfriGuard-plain](https://huggingface.co/datasets/adzcai/AfriGuard-plain) (no instruction, no tags). 1 epoch, 1 GPU, chat template of the base model, loss on the response only.

output_type.quote: each example is one of the safety system instructions plus the user prompt, and the target is `<safety>…</safety>` `<category>…</category>` `<response>…</response>`.

use_claim.quote: fine-tuned with full fine-tuning (DeepSpeed ZeRO-3) on israel/AfriGuard-inst

serving.notes: tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja, and it can insert image and video placeholders. config.json architecture is Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration and includes vision_config. generation_config.json sets token ids and use_cache, not temperature or top_p. trainer_state.json records global_step 23153, max_steps 23153, and train_batch_size 1. The card also lists gradient_accumulation_steps 2 and total_train_batch_size 2, and says both '1 GPU' and 'distributed_type: multi-GPU'. The named LlamaFactory repo was not found.
